method: Read each completed retained spatial NPZ. Factor the actual scored temporal operator O[20:,:] by full-thin SVD and fixed Hb loading by full-thin SVD. Project raw target via U_t U_t^T Y U_s U_s^T. Full left directions include weak or numerically unresolved directions, so this is the conservative relaxed temporal-space projection used for the stability audit. Recompute weighted factor projection using loading/SD and compare with retained certified_prediction. No latent coefficients or physiological variables are fitted.

interpretation.retained_D_space: energy fraction of the saved numerical least-squares prediction residual; it is not a certified exact projection distance or a certified lower bound
interpretation.stable_raw_fraction: independent conservative relaxed factor-subspace projection energy fraction; not an interval arithmetic certificate
interpretation.normal_equation_failures: retained as evidence of lost numerical orthogonality in the ill-conditioned latent-coordinate solve; the original tolerance is not increased
interpretation.weighted_certified_prediction: different quantity from raw fitted prediction: training-SD-weighted conservative factor-subspace projection, checked independently here
